f154cb7 Sanitize `this.doc` after `parseInternal` to prevent the `_findContentBySchemaText` fallback from returning unsanitized HTML containing scripts, event handlers, and other dangerous elements. Strips unsafe elements/attributes while preserving legitimate content like math scripts, media iframes, and video embeds. See #139

ea09d84 Fix #139: - Add _stripUnsafeElements() method that temoves <script>, <style>, <noscript> elements and on* event handler attributes from this.doc.body. This runs on the original document, not the clone. - Call _stripUnsafeElements() in parse() after both parseInternal() calls complete (so extractors and schema extraction still have access to script tags) but before _findContentBySchemaText() searches this.doc. This ensures the fallback path only returns sanitized HTML.
